name: episode-title-card-interrupt
intent: Live application shell pauses (dims + PAUSED meta), a finite title card interrupts (EPISODE // 12 / OUTPUT MAXIMUM), holds, then host UI resumes.

copy.liveInterrupted: Title card: OUTPUT MAXIMUM. Application paused.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Show dimmed app + title card immediately; hold 500ms; resume without slide animation

acceptance: Interrupt dims host app (opacity 0.35, grayscale 0.4) and app meta shows [PAUSED]
Title card slides in over 420ms and holds for 500ms with EPISODE // 12 copy
After hold, card dismisses over 320ms and host app returns to full opacity without [PAUSED]
Polite aria-live announces pause, title card, and resume phases
Reduced motion shows paused + card states instantly then resumes after holdMs
Restart message resets to idle running state deterministically
